title: Underground cities built before the Younger Dryas to survive catastrophe

tellings.quote: I believe that those were built well over 10,000 years ago over I mean they had to to me they had to have been built before the younger dras catastrophes

plain: A researcher called Matt, talking with podcast host Jesse Michels, says he believes the underground cities of Cappadocia in Turkey, huge networks of rooms dug into the rock, were built well over 10,000 years ago. In his view they had to be built before the Younger Dryas, a time of sudden climate upheaval near the end of the last ice age, as shelters to survive its disasters. If so, it would mean an advanced people existed far earlier than history usually allows.
